title: Amalfi Coast vs Cinque Terre: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Cinque Terre for hikers, budget travelers, and first-timers who want ease of access. Amalfi Coast for romance, luxury, and the most dramatic Mediterranean scenery. Both are mobbed in summer — shoulder season (April–May, September–October) is essential.

categories.name: Daily Budget
categories.summary: Cinque Terre is 20–30% cheaper. Mid-range stays €80–130/day vs Amalfi Coast €120–200/day, where even mid-range hotels charge a steep premium for the view.

categories.name: Scenery
categories.summary: Amalfi has sweeping cliffside panoramas and turquoise water. Cinque Terre has colorful villages stacked on steep terraces above the sea. Both are breathtaking in different ways.

categories.name: Hiking
categories.summary: Cinque Terre's Sentiero Azzurro (Blue Trail) connecting all 5 villages is one of Italy's best coastal hikes. Amalfi's Path of the Gods is spectacular but less accessible.

categories.name: Beaches
categories.summary: Amalfi Coast has better beaches — Positano's Spiaggia Grande, Marina di Praia, and Furore fjord. Cinque Terre's beaches are mostly rocky pebbles.

categories.name: Getting Around
categories.summary: Cinque Terre is easy — a single train line connects all 5 villages in minutes. Amalfi requires winding mountain buses or expensive ferries/taxis on a notoriously traffic-choked road.

categories.name: Day Trips
categories.summary: Amalfi: Pompeii, Herculaneum, Capri, Naples. Cinque Terre: Florence (1.5h), Pisa (1h), Portofino, Genoa. Both have excellent options.

categories.name: Accommodation
categories.summary: Cinque Terre mid-range hotels run €90–160/night. Amalfi Coast comparable quality costs €150–350/night, especially in Positano and Ravello.

categories.name: Crowds (Peak)
categories.summary: Both are heavily touristed in summer. Cinque Terre is manageable (each village has a cap system). Amalfi's single coastal road creates gridlock in July–August.

categories.name: Food & Wine
categories.summary: Amalfi: limoncello, seafood, sfogliatella. Cinque Terre: trofie al pesto, focaccia, Sciacchetrà dessert wine. Both are exceptional.

categories.name: Romance / Honeymoon
categories.summary: Amalfi wins for romance — cliffside dinners in Positano, luxury hotels with infinity pools, Ravello's sunset terrace concerts. Cinque Terre is more casual and backpacker-friendly.

categories.name: Accessibility
categories.summary: Cinque Terre is reachable by direct train from Florence, Genoa, and Milan. Amalfi Coast requires a connection to Sorrento or Salerno, then a bus or ferry.

faq.question: Is Amalfi Coast or Cinque Terre better for first-time visitors to Italy?
faq.answer: Cinque Terre for most first-timers — easier to reach, easier to navigate, and more budget-friendly. Amalfi Coast for romance seekers and those happy to splurge.

faq.question: Which is cheaper, Amalfi Coast or Cinque Terre?
faq.answer: Cinque Terre is 20–30% cheaper across accommodation, food, and transport.

faq.question: Can I visit both Amalfi Coast and Cinque Terre in one Italy trip?
faq.answer: Yes but they're far apart (8+ hours by train). Most travelers pick one. If you do both, allow 3+ nights each and don't try to day-trip between them.
